themes.title: Grok Bot enterprise wide deploy
themes.body: Musk (Q3 call): Grok Bot in early deployment with trusted customers; expects wide enterprise deployment within a few weeks. Usage grows per user over time; may consume most superintelligence compute.

themes.title: V3 Starlink rides Starship capacity
themes.body: CFO Bret Johnsen: through end of 2026 and 2027, deploy V3 broadband in meaningful volume; each Starship launch ramping toward >20× downlink capacity vs current Falcon 9 Starlink batches. Mobile V2 on Starship starting 2027.

themes.title: East Coast Starship via LC-39A
themes.body: Flight 16 planning tied to first Starship launch from Kennedy LC-39A before year-end 2026, after Flight 15. Vehicles would barge via You'll Thank Me Later.

themes.title: FAA PEIS: Starbase cadence ambition
themes.body: FAA programmatic EIS process underway that could eventually allow up to 456 Starship launches / 912 landings per year from Starbase (vs current 25/50). Phase 1 would raise to 100 launches. Early scoping — not approved.

themes.title: Raptor 3 / V3 booster facts (reported)
themes.body: V3 Super Heavy: three larger grid fins, built-in hot-staging, all-33 start. Reported Raptor 3: 250 tf thrust, 1,525 kg. Static fire validates engines, not ship heat shield or catch timing.

themes.title: Why this wall exists (local)
themes.body: Boyd tracks SpaceX/Elon/Starlink/xAI heavily. This remaster is a TokenMax burn-night ops wall: one glance for next T-minus, fleet size, and theme cards — not a trading terminal.

why_boyd_cares.title: Standing SpaceX / Elon overweight
why_boyd_cares.body: Jim · Interests burn snapshot (Oct 20–26) flagged standing overweight on Tesla/SPCX narratives plus Starlink geopolitics. This wall keeps launch NET and fleet counts one glance away during burn nights.
why_boyd_cares.source: Local interest notes (Jim snapshot + household context)

why_boyd_cares.title: Starlink as infrastructure story
why_boyd_cares.body: LIVE Q3: +1.6M customers, 174 markets, $5.2B connectivity revenue. Fleet >11k working sats. Useful when Boyd talks capacity, V3, or direct-to-cell without opening five tabs.

why_boyd_cares.title: Grok Bot is the tool doing the burn
why_boyd_cares.body: Musk's Q3 line — Grok Bot may use most superintelligence compute — is meta for TokenMax week: this dashboard itself is a Grok Bot weekly burn artifact on :4335.

why_boyd_cares.title: Flight 15 dual-catch watch window
why_boyd_cares.body: NET early November dual catch (if licensed) is the highest-drama public Starship milestone left in 2026. Wall countdown keeps the unofficial NET visible without pretending SpaceX published a clock.

why_boyd_cares.title: Not investment advice
why_boyd_cares.body: Wall displays public launch/status facts and household interest framing. No buy/sell recommendations. LIVE badges mark session-fetched public sources only.
